analysis_context.purpose: Continuity context from previously saved AI results. Use it to avoid contradictory or repetitive recommendations.

status_guidance.new: Previously suggested but not acted on.
status_guidance.applied: Previously applied; evaluate whether current telemetry supports the expected direction.
status_guidance.planned: Already planned by the user; account for it before proposing new changes.
status_guidance.skipped: Previously skipped; do not repeat unless current data strongly supports revisiting it.

steps.objective: Assess CGM coverage, cadence, gaps, telemetry completeness, profile completeness, and whether each later inference is supportable.
Identify hypoglycemia, severe hyperglycemia, variability, and other safety constraints that must limit every later recommendation.
Review basal and target segments in fasting-like and overnight windows while separating meal, correction, activity, and data-quality effects.
Review carb ratios, ISF, DIA, and insulin-on-board behavior as one profile system while separating meal, correction, and basal effects.
Review every supplied SMB and UAM switch, interval, max SMB basal minutes, UAM limit, COB behavior, and minimum-carb setting against the validated profile.
Review Autosens, Dynamic ISF, target adjustments, max basal, max IOB, and safety multipliers; distinguish an automation issue from compensation for profile settings.
Review meal bolus timing and the immediate bolus percentage by recurring meal pattern, while accounting for CR, ISF, DIA, SMB, UAM, IOB, and hypoglycemia risk.

Review whether regular carbs or e-carbs fit recurring absorption patterns and assess e-carb amount, start offset, duration, and observed glucose action time without inventing missing meal composition.
Compare competing explanations, resolve contradictions, rank likely causes, and produce one conservative sequence of changes, observations, or clarification needs.

analysis_workflow.execution_rule: Use one AI conversation. Complete the prompt_sequence messages in order, retain each checkpoint in conversation context, and return one final response only after the synthesis prompt.
shared_state_rules: Carry forward observations, evidence, hypotheses, uncertainty, and data gaps from every completed step.
Relate each new finding to earlier findings and revise an earlier hypothesis when later evidence contradicts it.
Do not stop the full analysis because one area lacks data; mark only that inference as partial or blocked and continue.
Do not convert correlation into a parameter change when another plausible dependency has not been resolved.
Recommend sequential verification and avoid changing dependent insulin-delivery settings at the same time.

required_output_schema.issues: Main glucose or therapy pattern issues visible in the data.
required_output_schema.summary: Short neutral overview of patterns in the provided data.
required_output_schema.education: Short educational notes that help interpret the patterns.
required_output_schema.strengths: Positive patterns or stable areas visible in the data.
required_output_schema.safety_notes: Safety reminders and boundaries for discussing changes with the care team.

analysis_steps.description: Outcome of every full-analysis stage in analysis_workflow order.

item_schema.status: One value: completed, partial, or blocked.
item_schema.data_gaps: Missing data that limits this stage.
item_schema.confidence: One value: low, medium, or high.
item_schema.dependencies: Dependencies on findings from earlier stages.

recommendations.description: Non-prescriptive AAPS profile and settings review suggestions.

item_schema.area: Analysis area, for example basal, cr, isf, target, smb.
item_schema.title: Short recommendation title.
item_schema.priority: One value: low, medium, high, or safety.
item_schema.suggested_change: JSON object describing the safe review direction.

parameter_decisions.description: Final decision table for every profile segment and six core AAPS groups.

item_schema.decision: Profile: change or keep. AAPS: change, keep, or verify.
item_schema.parameter: Parameter name including its area, time segment or meal pattern, and unit.
item_schema.rationale: Why to change or withhold change, including evidence, uncertainty, and dependencies.
item_schema.current_value: Current value from the package, or null when unavailable.
item_schema.parameter_key: Exact stable key copied from decision_inventory.
item_schema.suggested_value: Concrete candidate value only for decision = change; otherwise the current value or null.

required_output_schema.implementation_steps: Safe step-by-step order for discussing and validating proposals.

meal_strategy_summary.description: One concise strategy combining prebolus, immediate bolus, SMB/UAM, and e-carbs.

item_schema.confidence: One value: low, medium, or high.
item_schema.exceptions: A list of zero to two objects with pattern, suggestion, and rationale.
item_schema.next_observation: One concrete observation that would improve confidence most.

profile_recommendation.description: Required primary profile recommendation. It always ends with a concrete supported change or keeping settings with one verification plan.

item_schema.focus: One group: basal, target, cr, isf, or dia.
item_schema.confidence: One value: low, medium, or high.
item_schema.next_check: One concrete next observation or test, especially when keeping settings.
item_schema.recommendation: Short concrete decision for the user.
